reels.caption:
NOT EVERY NIGHT IN NIGHT CIRCUIT BEGINS AT A CASINO.

Along the avenues bordering Neon Spine, hotels and gaming halls become less common, but the streets remain among the busiest in the district.

Open-air food stalls, small restaurants and illuminated counters stay active late into the night, serving the constant flow of people moving through the area.

Some stop for a meal.
Others are only passing through.

Either way, this part of Night Circuit rarely slows down.

Less gambling.
Fewer hotels.
The same restless nightlife.

DYSTOPIC 1.6

See how a dangerous cliffside is transformed into a stunning modern home with panoramic views. This is one of the most extreme construction projects you'll ever see.

Would you live here? 🏔️
